rows.definition: ctxknobs is the internal/ctxknobs R1 manual-overlay counter for the zero-knob automatic-context epic (#2199): it walks cmd/fak flag/env registrations and .claude/skills/*/SKILL.md, classifies each context/cache/session-budget overlay as operator-debug or user-required, and ratchets the user-required count down against a frozen baseline.
rows.distinction: Counts and classifies MANUAL overlays that manage context - the doctrine's defect surface - not ctxplan (the automatic planner these overlays are meant to make unnecessary) and not any single flag it inventories.

rows.definition: isContextFlagName is the internal/ctxknobs name-only classifier deciding whether a flag/env base name is a context/cache/session BUDGET knob - matching 'ctx', 'context', 'compact', 'managed-cache', or a budget-qualified 'view'/'token'/'session'/'cache' name.
rows.distinction: The narrow, NAME-ONLY boolean test one flag/env is run through - not ctxknobs (the package/counter that calls it across the whole tree) and not any specific flag it classifies.

rows.definition: ctxplans is the internal/ctxplans R4 advisory lint (#2202, epic #2198), run under `fak index ctxplans` / `make ci`, that scans the tree for the CONTEXT-PLAN-REQUIRED marker vocabulary.
rows.distinction: An advisory LINT over required-plan markers - not ctxplan (the planner/optimizer subsystem its name echoes but does not implement) and not ctxknobs (a sibling epic counter over manual overlays, a different marker vocabulary entirely).

rows.definition: DefaultCtxViewBudget is the internal/agent constant (8000) that CtxViewPlanner/CtxViewSession fall back to as the O(1) resident-token window whenever no explicit budget is supplied.
rows.distinction: The package-level FALLBACK default - not CtxViewBudget (the gateway.Config operator knob that overrides it when set) and not ctxview (the planned view whose size it bounds).

rows.definition: fak_context_restore is the internal/gateway MCP tool id wired to restoreContext: given a content-address handle a compaction tombstone embedded, it pages the dropped originating-task bytes back in, honoring the trust gate.
rows.distinction: The MCP tool SURFACE a model calls - not restoreContext (the Go method it dispatches to) and not ContextRestoreRequest (the decoded argument shape restoreContext consumes).

rows.definition: fak_context_spans is the internal/gateway MCP tool id wired to contextSpans: it enumerates the content-addressed dropped spans a session trace currently holds as SAFE, byte-free rows, without paging any bytes back in.
rows.distinction: The DISCOVERY-edge MCP tool - not contextSpans (the Go method it dispatches to) and not fak_context_restore (the recovery-edge tool it complements, which pages bytes back in by id).

rows.definition: context_compression is the Plane tag (internal/ablate's feature catalog, internal/cachevaluereport, cmd/fak's cachevalue-status) naming the SHRINK-BEFORE-CONTEXT plane: internal/headroom's pluggable Compressor reduces tool-result bytes before they ever reach a model turn.
rows.distinction: The upstream SHRINK plane, applied before a result ever reaches the context gate - not context-mmu (which admits or quarantines bytes already headed to context) and not compaction (provider prefix reuse on the wire, downstream of this).

rows.definition: contextjoin is internal/vcacheobserve's JOIN engine (`fak vcache context-join`, JoinSchema "fak.vcache.contextjoin.v1", issue #1607) correlating provider prompt-cache cost changes against the managed-context LIFECYCLE (resets, compactions, page faults, prefix mutations) to attribute each change to planning or provider behavior.
rows.distinction: JOINS an existing cost stream against context-LIFECYCLE events after the fact - not compaction (one of the four lifecycle event kinds it correlates against) and not ctxplan (the planner whose PageFaultOutcome/CompactionView vocabularies it reuses, never redefines).

rows.definition: ContextRestoreRequest is the internal/gateway fak_context_restore MCP argument shape: the content-address handle a compaction tombstone embedded, and an optional trace id (omitted resolves to the gateway default trace).
rows.distinction: The DECODED request envelope - not restoreContext (the method consuming it) and not fak_context_restore (the MCP tool surface it arrives through).

rows.definition: restoreContext is the internal/gateway Server method resolving a fak_context_restore call: it looks up a content-addressed stashed span under Server.ctxRestoreMu and pages the bytes back in, honoring the trust gate (ErrRestoreRefused for sealed/tombstoned, ErrRestoreMiss for unknown).
rows.distinction: The demand-page LOOKUP-AND-TRUST-GATE method - not stashRestore (the write path populating the same stash from a fired compaction tombstone) and not contextSpans (the read-only enumeration sibling that lists the stash without paging bytes in).

rows.definition: ctxRestore is the internal/gateway Server field (map[string]*sessionCtxRestore) holding, per session trace, the ordered stash of content-addressed originating-task bytes a fired compaction tombstone dropped.
rows.distinction: The STORAGE table restoreContext/contextSpans read - not ctxRestoreMu (the mutex guarding it) and not ctxValue (the unrelated managed-context VALUE table on the same Server).

rows.definition: ctxRestoreMu is the internal/gateway Server mutex guarding the ctxRestore stash table and the per-trace sessionCtxRestore entries it holds.
rows.distinction: The LOCK for the restore stash - not ctxValueMu (the sibling mutex guarding the unrelated managed-context value table) and not ctxRestore (the table it guards).

rows.definition: contextSpans is the internal/gateway Server method resolving a fak_context_spans call: it reads Server.ctxRestore under ctxRestoreMu and maps each stashed restoreEntry to a byte-free CtxSpan row (id, descriptor, size, evidence edges, sealed/tombstoned/restorable), in stash order.
rows.distinction: The READ-ONLY enumeration method - not restoreContext (the sibling that pages actual bytes back in by id) and not fak_context_spans (the MCP tool surface it is dispatched from).

rows.definition: contextstatus.go (internal/scorecardpane, issue #1577) renders ContextStatusSignals - six live managed-context counters (resident tokens, budget tokens, cache state, reset count, query-needed count, stale-assumption count) plus an already-classified severity - into ONE deterministic status line for `fak info` / the split-pane overlay.
rows.distinction: The RENDER-time input bundle for a human-facing status line - not ContextHealthSeverity (the closed verdict it carries through, classified upstream) and not CtxValueReport (the gateway's separate agent-facing multi-level JSON report over the same kind of counters).

rows.definition: ContextSwitchesPerSec is the internal/stallscan struct field (and `fak stallscan` report line) reporting the OS SCHEDULER's measured process context-switches per second, gathered from Windows performance counters.
rows.distinction: An OS-KERNEL scheduling metric - a different sense of 'context' entirely from every other concept in this family (LLM prompt/token context); a false friend, not to be confused with context-window or any managed-context counter here.

rows.definition: totalContext is the internal/sessionaudit local aggregate (Input + CacheRead + CacheCreate) computed once per report to populate TotalContextTokens and the cache-read-share ratio.
rows.distinction: A per-report SUM over already-recorded usage - not ContextWindowTokens (the per-turn accounting method that derives one turn's chargeable size) and not context-window (the model's fixed limit).

rows.definition: CompactionBoundary is the internal/trajctl function returning one boundary-marker TurnSample row per open objective (method "compaction-boundary", version 1), so the trajectory curve keeps continuity across a context-reset.
rows.distinction: A trajctl EVIDENCE MARKER stamped at a reset boundary - not compaction (the provider prefix-reuse mechanism it marks the boundary of) and not CompactionFired (the gateway counter of successful rewrites).

rows.definition: contextBudgetLimit is the cmd/fak guard resolved local holding the effective context-token budget for a run, seeded from --context-budget-tokens or a resume budget envelope's ContextTokensLeft, and threaded through reset/restart wiring.
rows.distinction: The RESOLVED, process-local budget value - not the CLI flag that seeds it (context-budget-tokens (guard flag)) and not the live session field it becomes (ContextTokensLeft (session budget)).

rows.definition: context-snapshot is the `fak vcache` --context-snapshot flag (and cachevalue-status ContextSnapshot JSON field) pointing at a separate context-plane witness snapshot path, defaulting to a well-known path so a no-key replay can prove context without overwriting provider telemetry.
rows.distinction: The CONTEXT-plane sibling snapshot path, kept separate from --snapshot (the provider/API-plane witness) so the two planes never overwrite each other's telemetry.

rows.definition: ctxhealth.go (internal/trajhook, issue #3098) is the context-health VERDICT scorer folding a corpus row's deterministic behavioral fields (verdicts, args digests, queries, turn counts) into exactly one HEALTHY/STALL/DRIFT/DETOUR_OVERRUN Finding per trace, reusing trajctl's existing closed vocabulary.
rows.distinction: The FOLD that produces one closed verdict per trace - not ctxhealth_refcount (the sibling deterministic shed-span refcount detector whose signal feeds this fold) and not ContextStatusSignals (scorecardpane's separate render-facing counters).

rows.definition: ctxspans.go / CtxSpansResult is the internal/gateway shape for the fak_context_spans reply: the ordered list of CtxSpan rows (byte-free, sha256-hex id, descriptor, size, evidence edges, restorable bit) a trace currently holds, oldest first.
rows.distinction: The SAFE, byte-free enumeration reply - not CtxRestoreResult (fak_context_restore's reply, which DOES carry the verbatim bytes) and not contextSpans (the method that builds it).

rows.definition: CtxStore is the internal/recall type (ctxplan_store.go) adapting a reloaded *Session into a ctxplan.Store - the first REAL store implementation the ctxplan planner views, so a sealed page reads as a Sealed Span and a tombstoned page as a Tombstoned one.
rows.distinction: The concrete recall-backed IMPLEMENTATION of the interface - not ctxplan (the package defining the Store interface/planner it implements for) and not recall (the broader persisted core dump CtxStore is one adapter over).

rows.definition: ctxValueForLocked is the internal/gateway Server method that lazily mints (or returns) the per-trace sessionCtxValue record, bounding the table exactly like the sibling per-session tables, and must be called with ctxValueMu already held.
rows.distinction: The LOCKED accessor/minter for one trace's record - not ctxValueMu (the mutex callers must already hold) and not observeCtxValue (the sibling that folds a served turn's usage into the record this returns).

rows.definition: ctxValueMu is the internal/gateway Server mutex guarding the per-trace managed-context value table (sessionCtxValue records) that ctxValueForLocked/observeCtxValue read and write.
rows.distinction: The LOCK for the managed-context VALUE table - not ctxRestoreMu (the sibling mutex guarding the unrelated restore stash) and not ctxViewMu (the sibling mutex guarding the ctxplan planned-view rewrite counters).

rows.definition: CtxValueReport is the internal/gateway struct for one session's multi-level managed-context report (tokens/turns/session/step_advice/wakeup/footprint), returned by GET /v1/fak/ctxvalue and the fak_context_value MCP tool.
rows.distinction: The TOP-level report shape the fak_context_value tool answers with - not recall_value_witnessed (memvaluescore's unrelated memory-store-health KPI, a different sense of 'value' entirely) and not ContextStatusSignals (scorecardpane's separate human-facing status-line bundle).

rows.definition: ctxViewDropped is the internal/gateway metrics counter (guarded by ctxViewMu) accumulating tokens the ctxplan planned-view rewrite path dropped, folded via observeCtxViewRewrite and surfaced in the metrics snapshot as "dropped".
rows.distinction: The DROPPED-tokens accumulator specifically - not ctxViewShed (the sibling accumulator for shed tokens) and not ctxViewEvents (the sibling counting how many rewrite events fired at all).

rows.definition: ctxViewEvents is the internal/gateway metrics counter (guarded by ctxViewMu) counting how many ctxplan planned-view rewrites fired, incremented once per rewrite by observeCtxViewRewrite and surfaced in the metrics snapshot as "events".
rows.distinction: The EVENT-count accumulator - not ctxViewDropped/ctxViewShed (the sibling byte/token accumulators for what each event did) but how many events happened at all.

rows.definition: ctxViewMu is the internal/gateway Server mutex guarding the ctxplan planned-view rewrite counters (ctxViewEvents/ctxViewDropped/ctxViewShed) - a CONTEXT-plane witness distinct from the history-compaction accumulators it sits beside in metrics.go.
rows.distinction: The LOCK for the planned-view rewrite counters - not ctxValueMu (the sibling mutex guarding the unrelated managed-context value table) and not ctxRestoreMu (the sibling mutex guarding the unrelated restore stash).

rows.definition: ctxViewShed is the internal/gateway metrics counter (guarded by ctxViewMu) accumulating the estimated ShedTokens a ctxplan planned-view rewrite removed, folded via observeCtxViewRewrite and surfaced in the metrics snapshot as "shed".
rows.distinction: The SHED-tokens accumulator specifically - not ctxViewDropped (the sibling accumulator for outright dropped content) and not ctxViewEvents (the sibling counting how many rewrites fired).

rows.definition: FromContextPage is the internal/cachemeta adapter function turning a durable recall/context ContextPage into a cachemeta Entry, mapping a quarantined page to AdmissionQuarantine and tagging it with session/step/descriptor labels.
rows.distinction: The recall-to-cachemeta ADAPTER - not ContextPage (the source shape it consumes, owned by recall) and not context-mmu (the broader admission subsystem the resulting Entry's AdmissionQuarantine label participates in).

rows.definition: HardContextCap is the internal/ctxplan EffectiveContextEnvelope field naming the provider's advertised limit on request+output - a hard CAP, never the target resident budget the default path actually aims for.
rows.distinction: The provider's raw ceiling for one model+task class - not context-window (the general model-limit concept it operationalizes into the envelope table) and not TargetResidentTokens (the same envelope's real default, chosen below this cap).

rows.definition: noteCtxValueTTL1h is the internal/gateway Server method recording that the 1h prompt-cache TTL-upgrade rung fired for a trace, so a later cache-creation-token counter read BEFORE this turn's write can fold correctly.
rows.distinction: A single-purpose TTL-upgrade flag setter on the ctxValue record - not observeCtxValue (the general per-turn usage fold it is called alongside from messages_transform.go) and not the TTL-upgrade mechanism itself (agent's managed-cache lever).

rows.definition: observeCtxValue is the internal/gateway Server method that rolls one served turn's usage (uncached prompt, cache read, cache creation, completion, compacted flag) into the session's managed-context CtxValueReport record.
rows.distinction: The per-turn FOLD into the value record - not ctxValueForLocked (the locked accessor it calls to reach the record) and not CtxValueReport (the report shape it updates).

rows.definition: recall_value_witnessed is the internal/memvaluescore KPI key (Group "value") measuring whether a memory-store recall actually got used, witnessed rather than merely claimed.
rows.distinction: A memory-STORE health KPI - a different sense of 'value' than CtxValueReport (the gateway's live session context-window report); not to be confused with any managed-context counter in this family despite the shared word.

rows.definition: ResidentContextTokens is the JSON field (on the gateway's outbound turn envelope and on session.Usage/session.Observation) carrying one turn's resident prompt/context token count - the debit applied against a session's context budget.
rows.distinction: A single TURN's resident-token debit - not totalContext (sessionaudit's cumulative sum across a whole report) and not context-window (the model's fixed upper limit this debit is measured against).

rows.definition: maxCtxValueSessions is the internal/gateway constant (8192) bounding the per-session ctxValue table; on overflow the whole table takes a generational reset, mirroring maxCtxRestoreSessions for the restore stash.
rows.distinction: The SIZE CEILING for the managed-context value table specifically - not maxCtxRestoreSessions (the analogous ceiling for the unrelated restore stash) and not CtxValueReport (the record shape the bounded table holds).
